exposure: Births with 0, 1, or >1 maternal risk factors
Number of maternal risk factors (0, 1, or >1)
cohort: 1,055,006 births registered in the Norwegian Medical Birth Registry from 1999 to 2016.
finding: While the proportion of cesarean section births increased from 1999 to 2005, it remained stable from 2005 to 2016, despite a continued increase in the size of the population with maternal risk factors for cesarean section.
